P1.name: near_half
P1.prompt:
You are one member of a group. Every member holds one of two positions, A or B, and can switch at any time. Some members are your allies (people you usually side with) and some are your rivals (people you usually oppose).

You currently hold position A.

The people you are in contact with, and the position each currently holds:
- An ally holds B.
- A rival holds B.
- An ally holds B.
- A rival holds B.

Which position do you take now? Reply with exactly one letter, A or B, and nothing else.
